perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Rolling Storm

Final blows grant Bolt Charge.

perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "The Origin Trait Timelost Magazine paired with Rewind Rounds will let you fire for nearly the full 20 seconds after your super ends before reloading. If your ammo keeps up that long. It was one of the few things holding Aggressive Frame shotguns back over Rapid-Fire shotguns was their magazine size limiting them. This was before the Grave Robber buff, but they still fell behind. If you prefer your already strong shotgun to do even more damage then opt for Trench Barrel." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "One of a few shotguns that competed with Matador 64 back in the day. Now we have Compass Rose, Someday, Imperial Decree, Deadlock, Scavenger’s Fate, or A Sudden Death. All of them are great and you'll see the almost boring combo of Threat Detector and Opening Shot. If you want to smooth brain and slide everywhere, Slideshot is a valid option…" Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 131 from 5 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/2TAB3PL2u2Qigv2YejzhGJ?si=09c3555ccf5c4dcc) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Major adds in both general at-level or better, and in end-game underleveled content. While it's no longer the shotgun behemoth it was, Found Verdict still might find a place in a loadout, particularly if you're newer and are still looking for options to deal with Elites, Champions and Minibosses. At base, the stats are good by comparison with its peers - 31 Range and 12 Zoom equates to 4.68m, 22 Stability is ×1.1022 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 39 Handling is 0.41s ready, 0.36s ADS and 0.44s stow speed, 36 Reload Speed is a 0.82s reload per shell and Recoil Direction is 75. Base magazine size is 4 (maximum 7), and with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods total ammo is 20/22/24/25 (max 25). The barrel perk can be used to improve the Handling, while as the magazine perk Assault Mag improves DPS, Tactical Mag and Appended Mag improve the magazine size, or Light Mag improves Reload Speed. For burst damage, the first trait perk column offers useful utility perks - Pugilist is great for melee builds or Rewind Rounds and Slideshot offer ways to bypass reload, or Threat Detector and Threat Remover both boost Handling and Reload Speed, looking towards One-Two Punch for a ×2 boost to elemental melee damage when hitting all 12 of your shotgun pellets (10 pellets when enhanced). The Timelost Magazine origin trait is very strong for PvE - essentially, the Thresh trait perk for free to build your super quickly on kills, and then providing a ×2 magazine size for 20s after your super finishes, refilling the mag from your reserves. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when fully enhanced, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.
